QUOTE: "If the second call returns a negative value, the function logs at error level (length only, not the text) and returns `{}`. There is no error code, exception, or status. A missing vocab (`vocab_ == nullptr`) also returns `{}`, silently."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a failed tokenization returns `{}` (an empty vector) and that a missing vocab also returns `{}`, so the two cases give the same value. It says this about `LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize`, not the backend wrapper. The wrapper `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` only "passes the empty vector through", so it returns the same empty value too.
